description: Get the latest intraday reading for active U.S. listings (consolidated SIP: last trade, UTC time, session freshness, bid/ask) and for listings named MIC:TICKER on a Canadian exchange (XTSE, XTSX, XCNQ, NEOE; e.g. XTSE:RY) or Euronext (XPAR, XAMS, XBRU, XMSM, XOSL, MTAA, XLIS; e.g. XPAR:AIR), in the listing's currency. Needs a paid plan: for U.S. listings Pro is real time and Plus 15 minutes delayed; Canadian readings are real time on XTSE and XTSX and 15 minutes behind on XCNQ and NEOE, and Euronext readings are the last trade 15 minutes behind (Delayed=true). Free covers end-of-day data only and gets an upgrade note. Stale=true means the reading predates the session expected now and must not be reported as current. Missing readings are listed. For settled daily bars use GetLatestClosingPrices or GetStockPrices.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25): a bare ticker for a U.S. listing, MIC:TICKER for a Canadian or Euronext one.
